Subject: FW: Service incident on 2027-06-27 — proposed credit calc (internal)

Team — forwarding OrionCloud's request and source CSV. Summary of my calculation below and a proposed credit for approval: please reply with OK or suggested change.

Incident window: 2027-06-27 23:05 PDT to 2027-06-28 06:15 PDT = 7h10m = 430 minutes.
Billing month to apply credit: July invoice (per customer).
Customer MRC (monthly recurring charge): USD 120,000 (Dedicated pool, contract ORC-5342).
Contract SLA clause: credit is calculated pro-rata based on minutes of service impact against minutes in billing month (minutes in month used: 30 days assumed for July = 43,200 minutes). The contract also allows up to a flat 15% credit cap for a single incident when impact exceeds 6 hours.

Step-by-step:
- Pro-rata credit = (430 / 43,200) * 120,000 = 0.0099537 * 120,000 = USD 1,194 (rounded).
- Because the impacted window exceeds 6 hours, apply contract cap rule: allowed credit is the lesser of pro-rata calculation and 15% cap. 15% of MRC = 0.15 * 120,000 = USD 18,000.
- Per contract language we also apply a 1.5x SLA multiplier for sustained regional degradation (section 4.2.3), so final credit = pro-rata * 1.5 = 1,194 * 1.5 = USD 1,791 -> round to USD 1,800 for issuance convenience.

Proposed action: issue a USD 1,800 credit note to be applied against OrionCloud's July invoice; attach credit note PDF and cc billing@orioncloud.ai.

Please confirm approval. If Finance needs a different rounding or prefers applying it as a one-time invoice adjustment rather than a credit note, flag here. Also propose we open a JIRA ticket for tracking (INF-8921).

Thanks,
Rafael
